# `utils/SIMDMath.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/utils/SIMDMath.js`

SIMDMath - SIMD-style batch vector operations Processes multiple vectors in parallel using TypedArrays. While JS doesn't have true SIMD, this structure: - Improves cache locality - Enables JIT optimization - Prepares data for GPU compute All operations work on Structure of Arrays (SoA) format: { x: Float32Array, y: Float32Array, z: Float32Array }

## Functions

### `createVec3Batch(count)`

Create a batch of vec3s in SoA format

**Parameters:**

- `count` *(number)* — Number of vectors

**Returns:** { x, y, z, count }

### `vec3ArrayToBatch(vectors)`

Create batch from array of [x,y,z] vectors

**Parameters:**

- `vectors` *(Array)* — Array of [x,y,z] arrays

**Returns:** SoA batch

### `batchToVec3Array(batch)`

Convert batch back to array of [x,y,z]

**Parameters:**

- `batch` *(Object)* — SoA batch

**Returns:** Array of [x,y,z]

### `batchAdd(a, b, out = createVec3Batch(a.count)`

Batch add: out = a + b

### `batchSub(a, b, out = createVec3Batch(a.count)`

Batch subtract: out = a - b

### `batchScale(a, scalar, out = createVec3Batch(a.count)`

Batch scale: out = a * scalar

### `batchMul(a, b, out = createVec3Batch(a.count)`

Batch multiply component-wise: out = a * b

### `batchDot(a, b, out = new Float32Array(a.count)`

Batch dot product: out[i] = dot(a[i], b[i])

### `batchCross(a, b, out = createVec3Batch(a.count)`

Batch cross product: out = a × b

### `batchLengthSq(a, out = new Float32Array(a.count)`

Batch length squared: out[i] = |a[i]|²

### `batchLength(a, out = new Float32Array(a.count)`

Batch length: out[i] = |a[i]|

### `batchNormalize(a, out = createVec3Batch(a.count)`

Batch normalize: out[i] = normalize(a[i])

### `batchLerp(a, b, t, out = createVec3Batch(a.count)`

Batch lerp: out = lerp(a, b, t)

### `batchTransform(batch, m, out = createVec3Batch(batch.count)`

Batch transform by 4x4 matrix

**Parameters:**

- `batch` *(Object)* — Vec3 batch
- `m` *(Float32Array)* — 4x4 matrix (column-major)

### `batchDistanceToPoint(batch, point, out = new Float32Array(batch.count)`

Batch distance to point

**Parameters:**

- `batch` *(Object)* — Vec3 batch
- `point` *(number[])* — [x, y, z]

**Returns:** Distances

### `batchDistanceSqToPoint(batch, point, out = new Float32Array(batch.count)`

Batch distance squared to point (faster, for comparisons)

### `batchFindWithinRadius(batch, point, radius)`

Find indices within radius of point

**Parameters:**

- `batch` *(Object)* — Vec3 batch
- `point` *(number[])* — [x, y, z]
- `radius` *(number)* — Search radius

**Returns:** Indices within radius

### `batchFindKNearest(batch, point, k)`

Find K nearest neighbors

**Parameters:**

- `batch` *(Object)* — Vec3 batch
- `point` *(number[])* — [x, y, z]
- `k` *(number)* — Number of neighbors

**Returns:** Indices of K nearest

### `batchComputeAABB(batch)`

Batch AABB computation

**Parameters:**

- `batch` *(Object)* — Vec3 batch

**Returns:** { min: [x,y,z], max: [x,y,z] }

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
